Economy · India

India's August Exports Rise, Imports Show Mixed Trends

India's combined goods and services exports saw a 25.4 percent increase, reaching over $82 billion in August. Concurrently, imports from China during April-August rose to $65.49 billion. In contrast, India's reliance on Russian crude oil experienced a significant drop in August, though it is expected to increase subsequently. The data reflects varied trends in India's international trade during the specified periods.
